title: Data Collection For Patients With Sickle Cell Disease
official: Data Collection For Patients With Sickle Cell Disease
summary: To create a database of clinical information, participant /disease characteristics, and treatment history collected from patients with Sickle Cell Disease.
criteria:
Inclusion Criteria

1. Participants 18 years of age and older diagnosed with Sickle Cell Disease.
2. Participants treated at UT Physicians Sickle Center Cancer Center
3. Participants treated at UT MD Anderson Cancer Center

Exclusion Criteria None
